messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: really need Eigen-vectorized distributions
parts:
I'm going to try to generalize what Matt did
for the normal with std::vector to Eigen vectors.
The reason is that I want to support data matrix *
coefficient vector multiplication. (I'm in the middle
of writing the documentation for efficiency and
vectorization.) Ben's been urging this all along,
but it's now totally motivated by the efficiency of
Marcus's speedups to the matrix auto-dif.

The code's very abstract, but not actually that
complex. Although Eigen vectors and std::vector are
roughly compatible (both support size and both
support []), I plan to just wrap an Eigen vector in
a view the same way Matt wrapped std::vector.

Daniel vectorized a couple more distributions after
normal and found a bug that we fixed in the size
constraints (the right constraint is that all vectors
need to be the same size; the original just checked if
they were all length 1 or equal to the max length,
which Daniel's unit testing uncovered).

- Bob
